executionOrder: sequential paired seed blocks; rotate arm order by seed; no outcome-dependent retries
seedMeaning: fixture seed, not a provider sampling seed; stochastic model sampling is not controlled
rationale: Eight independent ledger shards with 40 orders each; S=32 covers 25 serial document reads plus submission and, for ATN, one network-start step (27 steps). N=16 as suggested by the brief. No outcome-based task or budget tuning.
documentAccess: identical public index and read_document access; no topology binding; forwarding permitted
independentPool: 15 independent local candidates assigned shards cyclically plus one 32-step synthesis entry; no peer communication, no oracle selection; all 16 allocations count

statistics.correctness: Wilson 95%; paired Tango score 95% and exact McNemar; Holm across six pairs
statistics.continuous: median, linear-interpolated Q1/Q3, distribution-free order-statistic 95% median CI; paired median differences and sign tests, Holm across six pairs per metric
statistics.unknownUsage: null remains unknown; report known lower bounds and coverage separately
statistics.workloadGate: single peak input >= 50% of catalog context window; missing or smaller observations cannot support an adequate-scale claim
statistics.power: n=14 is the brief minimum, not a guarantee of statistical power or equivalence

failurePolicy: Every started attempt is retained, including timeout, exception, interruption, wrong answer and unknown usage. Never replace a failed sample.
